nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a complex number with $|q| < 1$. Write $(a;q)_\infty = \prod_{n \ge 0} (1 - a q^n)$ and $f_k = (q^k;q^k)_\infty$, and let $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function. Then $f(q,q) f_1^2 f_4^2 = f_2^5$, $f(q,q^3) f_1 = f_2^2$, $f(-q,-q) f_2 = f_1^2$, $f(-q,-q^3) f_2 = f_1 f_4$, $f(q,-q^2) f_1 f_4 = f_2^3$, $(-q;q^2)_\infty f_1 f_4 = f_2^2$ and…
nodes.title: Eta-quotients of Ramanujan's theta functions

nodes.summary: Let $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function. For complex numbers $a, b, c, d$ with $ab = cd$ and $|ab| < 1$, $f(a,b) f(c,d) + f(-a,-b) f(-c,-d) = 2 f(ac,bd) f(ad,bc)$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's theta function: sum of products when $ab = cd$

nodes.summary: Let $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function. For complex numbers $a, b, c, d$ with $ab = cd$, $|ab| < 1$, $c \ne 0$ and $d \ne 0$, $f(a,b) f(c,d) - f(-a,-b) f(-c,-d) = 2a \, f(b/c, ac^2 d) \, f(b/d, acd^2)$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's theta function: difference of products when $ab = cd$

nodes.summary: Let $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function and $(a;q)_\infty = \prod_{n \ge 0} (1 - a q^n)$. For every complex number $q$ with $|q| < 1$, $f(q,q^5) = (-q;q^2)_\infty \, f(-q^3,-q^9)$, that is, $f(q,q^5) = \chi(q) \psi(-q^3)$ with $\chi(q) = (-q;q^2)_\infty$ and $\psi(q) = f(q,q^3)$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's theta function at $(q, q^5)$

nodes.summary: Let $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function and $(a;q)_\infty = \prod_{n \ge 0} (1 - a q^n)$. For every complex number $q$ with $|q| < 1$, $f(q,q^2) \, (q;q^2)_\infty = f(-q^3,-q^3)$, that is, $f(q,q^2) = \varphi(-q^3)/\chi(-q)$ with the denominator cleared, where $\varphi(q) = f(q,q)$ and $\chi(-q) = (q;q^2)_\infty$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's theta function at $(q, q^2)$

nodes.summary: Let $f(a,b) = \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} a^{n(n+1)/2} b^{n(n-1)/2}$ be Ramanujan's theta function and write $f(-x) = f(-x,-x^2)$. For every complex number $q$ with $|q| < 1$, $f(-q,-q^8) f(-q^2,-q^7) f(-q^4,-q^5) f(-q^3) = f(-q) f(-q^9)^3$, that is, $f(-q,-q^8) f(-q^2,-q^7) f(-q^4,-q^5) = f(-q) f^3(-q^9)/f(-q^3)$ with the denominator cleared.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
